messages:
maria_cs: Heads up — Riverton renewal scheduled for next Tue. Legal flagged vendor-code mismatch and they're pushing for Net45. Also asking if we can shorten to 9mo instead of 12mo to align budget cycle. Thoughts? :thinking:
ryan_ae: ah ok. do we have PO on file or are they paying by CC?
kyle_revops: No PO yet. Procurement said they need vendor code updated before issuing PO. If we switch to Net45 we need finance signoff on credit terms.
maria_cs: Procurement asked for a copy of the SOW with the vendor code embedded. I can send but need the correct vendor code — legal? @anna_legal any quick lookup?
anna_legal: Checking — the entity on the account is "Riverton Labs, Inc." but the vendor code on our contract template is for a prior acquisition. Use VC-4832 for EU entities, but for Riverton US we need VC-9912. I'll patch the SOW text and paste below.
anna_legal: ```SOW: Billing entity: "Riverton Labs, Inc."
Vendor code: VC-9912
Payment terms: Net45 (if approved)
Term: 09 months (prorated)```
tess_ops: Thanks. If we do 9mo prorate we'll need to adjust the seat true-up schedule and prorated invoice date — finance needs the start/end dates to calc amounts. Maria can you confirm start date?
maria_cs: Start date requested is 2026-04-01. We would invoice on signing for the 9 months and prorate monthly usage true-ups.
kyle_revops: FYI pricing change: 9mo term would keep the same ARR but pro-rate total. No discount impact. Sales ok with that.
ryan_ae: For signature path — customer prefers DocuSign and delegated signer is their procurement lead (not the legal signatory). Is delegated signer allowed?
anna_legal: Delegated signer ok if we have written delegation. Ask procurement to attach a delegation memo to the DocuSign envelope. We'll accept Docusign.
maria_cs: I'll send updated SOW with VC-9912 and Net45 note, request delegation memo, and attach invoice draft. Can someone confirm the invoice template name?
tess_ops: Use template INV-2024-Standard-PO. I'll prefill billing address and closing dates after you share final SOW.
docusign-bot: DocuSign envelope created (env_0a1b). Reminder: attach delegation memo and set role "Procurement Signer".
maria_cs: Great — action items: (1) I send patched SOW + invoice draft today, (2) procurement to issue PO after vendor code/Net45 confirmed, (3) @anna_legal to review delegation memo if supplied. I'll update this thread when envelope sent. :+1:
ryan_ae: Thanks team. If PO slips >5 business days, we'll fallback to CC and a short-term interim invoice. Keep me looped.
maria_cs: noted, will ping if PO not in by EOD Thu.
